№1.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your favorite hobby.
№1.sovol_uz: Sevimli mashg‘ulotingiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№1.jovob_en: My favorite hobby is reading books. I like reading because it helps me learn new words and improve my English. It also makes me feel relaxed after a long day. I usually read short stories and interesting books. I read books almost every day, especially in the evening before I sleep.
№1.jovob_uz: Mening sevimli mashg‘ulotim kitob o‘qishdir. Men kitob o‘qishni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki u menga yangi so‘zlarni o‘rganishga va ingliz tilimni yaxshilashga yordam beradi. Shuningdek, u meni uzoq kundan keyin tinchlantiradi. Men odatda qisqa hikoyalar va qiziqarli kitoblarni o‘qiyman. Men deyarli har kuni, ayniqsa kechqurun uxlashdan oldin kitob o‘qiyman.

№2.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your family.
№2.jovob_en: There are five people in my family: my father, my mother, my brother, my sister, and me. My father works in an office, and my mother is a teacher. My brother likes football, and my sister enjoys drawing. In the evening, we have dinner together and talk about our day.
№2.jovob_uz: Mening oilamda besh kishi bor: otam, onam, akam, singlim va men. Otam ofisda ishlaydi, onam esa o‘qituvchi. Akam futbolni yaxshi ko‘radi, singlim esa rasm chizishni yoqtiradi. Kechqurun biz birga ovqatlanamiz va kunimiz haqida suhbatlashamiz.

№3.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your school.
№3.jovob_en: I study at a big and modern school. My classmates are friendly and helpful. We study and play together. My teachers are kind and explain lessons clearly. Our school has a large building, a library, and football and basketball stadiums. I like my school because it is comfortable and interesting.
№3.jovob_uz: Men katta va zamonaviy maktabda o‘qiyman. Sinfdoshlarim do‘stona va yordam berishga tayyor. Biz birga o‘qiymiz va o‘ynaymiz. O‘qituvchilarim mehribon va darslarni tushunarli tushuntiradi. Maktabimizda katta bino, kutubxona va futbol hamda basketbol maydonlari bor. Men maktabimni yaxshi ko‘raman.

№4.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your favourite holiday.
№4.sovol_uz: Sevimli bayramingiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№4.jovob_en: My favourite holiday is Eid. I like it because I can spend time with my family and relatives. On this day, we cook traditional food like plov and sweets. We visit our relatives and say kind words to each other. I feel very happy and excited on this special day.
№4.jovob_uz: Mening sevimli bayramim Hayit. Men uni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki bu kunda oilam va qarindoshlarim bilan vaqt o‘tkazaman. Bu kunda biz palov va shirinliklar tayyorlaymiz. Qarindoshlarimizni ziyorat qilamiz va bir-birimizga yaxshi tilaklar aytamiz. Bu kun meni juda xursand qiladi.

№5.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your city.
№5.jovob_en: I live in a beautiful city. There are many markets where people buy fresh fruits and vegetables. The parks are green and clean. Many families walk and relax there. There are also tall buildings, schools, and shops. I like my city because it is peaceful and comfortable to live in.
№5.jovob_uz: Men chiroyli shaharda yashayman. Bu yerda odamlar yangi meva va sabzavot sotib oladigan ko‘plab bozorlar bor. Bog‘lar yashil va toza. Ko‘plab oilalar u yerda sayr qiladi. Shuningdek, baland binolar, maktablar va do‘konlar bor. Men shahrimni yaxshi ko‘raman.

№6.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your last birthday.
№6.sovol_uz: Oxirgi tug‘ilgan kuningiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№6.jovob_en: My last birthday was in July. I celebrated it at home with my family and close friends. We ate delicious food and a big chocolate cake. My friends gave me nice presents. We talked, laughed, and took many photos. It was a very happy and memorable day for me.
№6.jovob_uz: Oxirgi tug‘ilgan kunim iyul oyida bo‘ldi. Men uni uyda oilam va yaqin do‘stlarim bilan nishonladim. Biz mazali ovqatlar va katta shokoladli tort yedik. Do‘stlarim menga sovg‘alar berdi. Biz suhbatlashdik va suratga tushdik. Bu juda baxtli kun edi.

№7.sovol_en: Write a small essay about a place you like.
№7.sovol_uz: Yoqtirgan joyingiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№7.jovob_en: One place I like is the park near my house. It is not far from my home. There are many trees and beautiful flowers. I can see children playing and families walking. I usually go there to relax and breathe fresh air. I feel calm and happy there.
№7.jovob_uz: Men yoqtiradigan joylardan biri uyim yaqinidagi bog‘. U uyimdan uzoq emas. U yerda ko‘plab daraxtlar va chiroyli gullar bor. Men bolalar o‘ynayotganini va oilalar sayr qilayotganini ko‘raman. Odatda u yerga dam olish uchun boraman.

№8.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your house or flat.
№8.sovol_uz: Uyingiz yoki kvartirangiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№8.jovob_en: I live in a comfortable house. It has four rooms: a living room, two bedrooms, and a kitchen. My favorite room is my bedroom because I can study and rest there. I like my house because it is clean, quiet, and close to my school.
№8.jovob_uz: Men qulay uyda yashayman. Unda to‘rtta xona bor: mehmonxona, ikkita yotoqxona va oshxona. Mening sevimli xonam yotoqxonam, chunki u yerda o‘qiyman va dam olaman. Uylim toza va tinch.

№9.sovol_en: Write a small essay about yourself.
№9.jovob_en: My name is Elyor, and I am a university student. I am from Uzbekistan. I am friendly and hardworking. In my free time, I like reading books and learning English. I also enjoy listening to music. My goal is to become a successful person in the future.
№9.jovob_uz: Mening ismim Elyor, men universitet talabasisiman. Men O‘zbekistondanman. Men do‘stona va mehnatsevarman. Bo‘sh vaqtimda kitob o‘qishni va ingliz tilini o‘rganishni yaxshi ko‘raman. Kelajakda muvaffaqiyatli inson bo‘lishni xohlayman.

№10.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your favorite thing.
№10.sovol_uz: Sevimli narsangiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№10.jovob_en: My favorite thing is my smartphone. I bought it last year with my own money. I use it to study English, watch useful videos, and talk to my friends. It helps me in my daily life. I like it because it is very useful and important for me.
№10.jovob_uz: Mening sevimli narsam smartfonim. Uni o‘tgan yili o‘z pulimga sotib oldim. Men undan ingliz tilini o‘rganish, foydali videolar ko‘rish va do‘stlarim bilan gaplashish uchun foydalanaman. U kundalik hayotimda juda foydali.
